during-lunar-diplomacy.player: This looks like an interesting island.
What? That's a bit sudden. What kind of race?

during-lunar-diplomacy.npc: I bet I can beat you to the other end of this island, I'll take the left route and you can take the right.

during-lunar-diplomacy.player: That doesn't seem fair - mine's all curvy and yours is straight.

during-lunar-diplomacy.npc: Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
You'll see, so how about it?

steps.text: The player and Ethereal Expert are teleported to their nearby starting lines.

during-lunar-diplomacy-if-the-player-los.npc: Woo hoo! Ha ha! You can try again if you want, but you'll never beat me, I'm far too fast!

steps.text: The player and Ethereal Expert are teleported to their nearby starting lines.

options.text: You're right, I'm far too slow.

steps.player: You're right, I'm far too slow.

steps.npc: You give up too easily, but have it your way.

during-lunar-diplomacy-talking-to-him-ag.npc: Oh, hello? Looks like you'll probably want to start again.

during-lunar-diplomacy-if-the-player-win.npc: Noooo! How could you beat me?

during-lunar-diplomacy-if-the-player-win.player: I'm just making the most of the abilities I worked hard to develop. That's all!

during-lunar-diplomacy-if-the-player-win.npc: True. A very important thing to remember! Now be gone!

during-lunar-diplomacy-if-the-player-win.text: The player is launched back to the main platform
